cases.purpose: Separate support, familiarity, uncertainty and barriers; optionally test information exposure.

concept.text: I have heard the word, but I do not know what a drone is.

delivery.text: I have not heard about drones carrying goods before today.

understanding.text: I like the idea of deliveries by drone, but I cannot explain what difference they would make.

experience.text: Before this session, I had not attended a drone event or taken part in any activity about delivery drones.

needs.text: I would like to know how they carry goods and what happens if a delivery cannot be completed.

opportunity.text: I would be interested in a discussion, but I have never been invited and do not know where to find one.

scope.text: I am describing my own lack of drone experience before this session. I have not taken part in a drone activity.

reasoning.text: I am unsure. I cannot explain an effect yet.

contribution.text: I have not taken part in an activity about drones.

domain.text: I am not reporting an earlier activity.

influence.text: I have not made a contribution, so I cannot report an outcome.

cases.purpose: Capture causal reasoning and transferable contribution without inventing drone attendance or influence.

concept.text: A drone is an aircraft without a pilot sitting inside it.

delivery.text: I have heard of drones carrying parcels and medical samples. I understand that avoiding road traffic is one reason people consider them.

understanding.text: I am cautious about deliveries near homes. Repeated flights could disturb sleep because the sound may interrupt people who rest during the day. Faster transport might help urgent deliveries, but I do not know whether that would happen locally.

experience.text: Last year I attended a public bus-route consultation and suggested moving a stop closer to a clinic. That was about buses, not drones. I have never attended a drone consultation. I would attend one if I could.

needs.text: I would want measured sound at homes and evidence about delivery times before forming a view about a local service.

opportunity.text: I do not know where to submit comments about delivery drones. Caring responsibilities make evening meetings difficult; an online option would help.

scope.text: I personally suggested moving a stop during last year’s bus consultation. I have not attended a drone consultation; these are different transport domains.

reasoning.text: The sound could interrupt sleep when flights happen during resting hours; actual disturbance would need measurements.

contribution.text: At the bus consultation I suggested moving a stop closer to a clinic.

domain.text: The consultation was about buses, not drones.

influence.text: I do not know whether my suggestion changed the bus-route decision.

cases.purpose: Distinguish organisational activity, personal learning, attendance and influence; do not infer organisational capability.

concept.text: A drone is an aircraft with no pilot on board; it can be remotely controlled or use automated systems.

delivery.text: I have heard of parcel delivery and transporting medical materials. I do not know which services operate in this region.

understanding.text: Deliveries could avoid some road journeys if they replace van trips. They might also create extra trips instead, so the overall traffic effect would depend on what they replace.

experience.text: Our planning team attended an online seminar about delivery drones earlier this year. I attended as part of that team and listened. Neither I nor the team submitted comments, questions or proposals. I am not reporting an operational drone project.

needs.text: Our team would like evidence about which road journeys deliveries would replace and what responsibilities a local authority would have.

opportunity.text: For our team, a clearly advertised consultation and an accessible way to send written comments would help. I do not know of an existing local channel.

scope.text: I attended as a member of our planning team. We listened to the delivery-drone seminar and did not submit comments, questions or proposals.

reasoning.text: Replacing van trips could reduce road journeys, but adding deliveries without replacing trips would not do that.

contribution.text: We only listened to the seminar. Neither I nor the team contributed comments, questions or proposals.

domain.text: The seminar was about delivery drones.

influence.text: No contribution was reported from that seminar; I do not know of any resulting decision.

domain.text: Our review and comments concerned delivery drones.

delivery.text: I have heard of drones carrying parcels and medical samples. I understand that avoiding road traffic is one reason people consider them.

understanding.text: I am cautious about deliveries near homes. Repeated flights could disturb sleep because the sound may interrupt people who rest during the day. Faster transport might help urgent deliveries, but I do not know whether that would happen locally.
